projects.name: Corporate Financial & Stock Management Platform
highlights: Built and maintained a full-stack web application for employee stock ownership plans, retirement accounts (401k, Profit Sharing), and vesting schedules using Meteor, Node.js, and Blaze.
Handled bulk data imports, financial growth calculations, and reporting features backed by MongoDB.
Automated version control, releases, and workflow pipelines using GitHub Actions.

projects.name: Enterprise Life Settlements & Policy Servicing Backend
highlights: Migrated backend services from Java 1.8 to Java 17 with Spring Boot to modernize the system and improve performance.
Integrated Camunda for process workflows and Azure OCR to automatically read text from PDFs and scanned documents.
Managed cloud infrastructure on AWS (RDS, S3, CloudWatch) and ran containerized environments with Docker on EC2.
Built frontend features using Angular and worked with Atlassian Jira, GitHub, and Maven inside IntelliJ.

Adopted AI-driven development workflows (using GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code), shifting toward a model where AI handled the primary coding while we focused on reviewing, testing, and guiding the logic.

projects.name: Banking Sector
highlights: Worked on building and improving core banking applications used to manage business loans, credit approvals, and interest rates.
Built, migrated, and integrated Micro Frontends (MFEs) into the main banking platform, keeping modules independent and clean.
Developed multi-screen user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Redux, managing complex forms and global state.
Connected frontend apps with backend services via Axios, working alongside Java / Spring Boot and BFF layers.
Wrote unit tests to maintain solid code quality, keeping test coverage above 80%.
Handled daily bug fixes, code maintenance, and deployments using Jenkins, Argo, Kubernetes (GCP), Bitbucket, and Jira in an Agile team.

projects.name: B2B Fintech Platform
highlights: Developed financial management and payment processing features for a B2B fintech platform, ensuring clean and responsive layouts for laptops and tablets using React, TypeScript, Redux, and Bootstrap.
Connected frontend interfaces with Node.js and GraphQL backend services to handle secure data flow and transactions.
Implemented unit and integration testing practices to support application reliability and maintainability.

projects.name: Mobile Fintech Features
highlights: Developed core mobile features including payments, transfers, purchases, and account management capabilities using React Native, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Built accurate user interfaces from Figma designs following a pixel-to-pixel approach, collaborating closely with the mobile team.

projects.name: Pharmaceutical Digital Platform (GSK Project)
highlights: Developed and maintained frontend features for digital web applications in the pharmaceutical industry, building modern user interfaces using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Redux.
Connected web applications with backend services and APIs, ensuring reliable data flow and smooth user experiences across multi-screen workflows.
Collaborated within multidisciplinary product teams following agile methodologies, and participated in internal tech communities to share knowledge and maintain high code quality standards.
Developed core dashboard components for enterprise cybersecurity products, improving user tracking, log management, and real-time data visualization.
Implemented enhancements and new functionality for a global music industry platform supporting artists, albums, and content management.
Contributed to both front-end and back-end development using C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, and related web technologies.
Designed, maintained, and modernized banking systems, intranet platforms, and customer-facing applications.
Delivered full-stack solutions using C#, .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, SQL Server, and JavaScript.
Maintained and enhanced business-critical banking applications and implemented new functionality across multiple banking products.
